Timeline: busy days and the sideways scroll

Proposal for the CEO; nothing is built. Every frame is clickable: tap a day row to open its Day view (Back returns), tap Key for the legend; hover or focus a row to see what a screen reader reads for it. Data is the fictional sample from docs/PRODUCT.md (today 15 Oct 2026). Rows with a small grey dot by the date (11 Oct, 3 kinds; 7 Oct, 5 kinds) are illustrative busy days, not sample data; 14 Oct (vet x2, symptoms) is sample data. With Option A badges the three fictional notes of the badges proposal are added (14, 13, 10 Oct), so 14 Oct becomes a 3-kind day and 7 Oct a 6-kind day. Two extra lanes adds two fictional item lanes to stand in for a real log with more items: that is what narrows the Events column on the real iPhone.

0. Today's build: why it scrolls sideways and stacks three badges Problem

Both frames use today's code rules (column minimums, Events column at least 48 px, badges wrap freely) with the two extra lanes. At 390 px the Events column is squeezed to 54 px: a 5-kind day needs three lines (60 px) in a 44 px row, so badges spill over the hairlines. At 360 px the day-part columns plus the 48 px Events minimum are wider than the list, so every row is 24 px wider than the screen and the list scrolls sideways, while the Key bar and the day-parts bar stay put and drift out of line with the rows. Try dragging the list sideways.

1. Three ways to show a busy day

All three use the fixed layout fix from the README (columns give up spare padding first, Events column at least 60 px, no sideways scroll) and the same priority order as the badges proposal: vet, symptoms, note, photo, Frontline, deworming. Row height stays 44 px; badges stay 18 px; the whole row still opens the Day view, which lists everything. Switch Phone width and Columns to see the tightest case (360 px, two extra lanes: Events column 60 px).

2. Tablet (768) and desktop (1280) Option 3

The app column is capped at 560 px (global.css .app), so on tablet and desktop the Events column is about 270 px wide and every option shows all kinds on one line; the busy-day rule never triggers there. Frames are scaled down; click a frame's caption button for 100 %.
